summary: Review an actual coding session and recommend targeted improvements to navigation, checks, instructions, and information access.

supporting_disposition.reason: Preserve source UI metadata and invocation policy.
Copy repository MIT license and attribution into derived package.

deltas.change: Use causal candidates instead of category completion
deltas.reason: Connect each recommendation to a session event, mechanism, and observable next-run effect.
deltas.tradeoff: Requires more reasoning per recommendation and often yields fewer suggestions.

deltas.reason: Prefer mechanical enforcement when the pattern and maintenance economics justify it.
deltas.tradeoff: Some rare mechanical mistakes will remain handled by ordinary review.

deltas.reason: Give implementers critical invariants when needed instead of reserving all standards for reviewers.
deltas.tradeoff: May add a small amount of implementation context.

deltas.reason: Present or prepare improvements without treating retrospective analysis as permission to alter global tooling.
deltas.tradeoff: Some useful changes remain proposals until implementation is in scope.

deltas.reason: Treat the source as a substantive beta procedure despite its bucket description as a stub.
deltas.tradeoff: Readers must carry a slightly untidy upstream status distinction.

deltas.change: Adapt Codex packaging without changing invocation
deltas.reason: Omit Claude-only disable-model-invocation and argument-hint keys while preserving explicit-only policy in the copied agents/openai.yaml.
deltas.tradeoff: The study package targets Codex metadata rather than being a byte-identical cross-host manifest.
